description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for Microsoft Windows Event Log records relayed as one-line Windows Event XML, with fixture-backed routing for Security logon success/failure, Kerberos TGT/TGS/pre-auth failures, NTLM credential validation failure, account creation/deletion/change, group membership, audit log clearing, scheduled-task creation, process creation, PowerShell script block, Defender detection, object access, audit-policy change, and service-installation events.

normalized_fields.subject_logon_id: SubjectLogonId for Security audit events where present
normalized_fields.task_content: TaskContent XML payload for scheduled-task creation events
normalized_fields.user_account_control: UserAccountControl raw token for account-change events
normalized_fields.package_name: PackageName authentication package for credential-validation events
normalized_fields.service_sid: ServiceSid for Kerberos ticket service context
normalized_fields.transmitted_services: TransmittedServices for Kerberos constrained delegation context
normalized_fields.cert_issuer_name: CertIssuerName for certificate-backed Kerberos authentication where emitted
normalized_fields.cert_serial_number: CertSerialNumber for certificate-backed Kerberos authentication where emitted
normalized_fields.cert_thumbprint: CertThumbprint for certificate-backed Kerberos authentication where emitted

supported_transports.notes: Dedicated TCP listener for one-line Windows Event XML from WEF/WEC, NXLog, Fluent Bit, Cribl, or equivalent relay.

supported_transports.label: TLS/RFC5425 syslog
supported_transports.notes: Preferred for production if the local SC4S deployment provisions TLS for this source.

RFC5424-style wrapper produced by the send helper for TCP relay into SC4S TEST

evidence_boundaries: not native EVTX or collector-normalized JSON support
not HEC/Splunk read-back evidence until the harness is actually run
explicit_gaps: Live Windows host/domain-controller relay emission is not proven by this harness.
WEF/WEC/NXLog/Fluent Bit/Cribl wrapper behavior and checkpoint/custody are not proven.
Native EVTX, collector-normalized JSON, and multiline XML export variants are not implemented by this harness.
SC4S listener replay, HEC delivery, and Splunk indexed read-back are not evidence until the harness is actually run in a permitted Docker lab.
Trust/quality labels remain curated/unverified until replay/read-back or production-equivalent evidence supports promotion.

timestamp_policy.primary_timezone: UTC when SystemTime ends in Z
requires_source_timezone_when_fields_mis: collector relay timezone or syslog envelope timezone
timestamp_policy.notes: Fixtures use UTC SystemTime values. Production relays must preserve timezone-qualified TimeCreated/SystemTime or document collector timezone.

field_delimiting.escape_policy: XML escaping; fixtures use example domains and RFC5737 documentation IPs
field_delimiting.notes: Each physical line is one complete Event XML record; multiline EVTX/XML export is not represented.

source.reference: Microsoft Learn Windows Event XML schema and public Windows security auditing, PowerShell, and Defender event references; synthetic-equivalent fixtures authored from documented XML structure.
source.notes: Fixtures use example host/domain names and RFC5737 documentation IP addresses; no customer Windows events or proprietary TA content are included.

curation.notes: Selected from Milestone 8 P0 operating-system telemetry backlog as the highest-value missing pack foundation. Initial scope is conservative XML relay coverage, not full Windows TA parity or field validation. 2026-06-14 hardening added Microsoft Learn-grounded failed-logon and account-creation XML fixtures plus Splunk read-back fields without trust promotion. 2026-06-14 follow-up added Microsoft Learn-grounded object-access/audit-policy/service-installation fixtures and read-back fields without trust promotion. 2026-06-15 follow-up added Microsoft Learn-grounded account-deletion, group-membership, audit-log-cleared, and scheduled-task creation fixtures/read-back fields without trust promotion. 2026-06-18 hardening added Microsoft Learn-grounded Event 4776 NTLM credential-validation fixture/read-back fields without trust promotion. 2026-06-22 hardening added Microsoft Learn-grounded Kerberos Event 4768/4769/4771 fixture/read-back fields without trust promotion.

pack_variants.label: WEF/WEC or collector-relayed Windows Event XML
pack_variants.description: Default initial variant for one complete Windows Event XML record per line, optionally syslog-wrapped by a collector relay.
known_limitations: Synthetic-equivalent fixtures only; no live Windows relay capture or Splunk read-back.
One-line XML relay shape only; native EVTX, multiline XML exports, and JSON collector variants require separate fixtures and validation.
Security Event 4625 failed-logon and 4720 account-creation fixtures are synthetic-equivalent and documentation-grounded; no live Windows relay capture or read-back.
Security Event 4663 object-access, 4719 audit-policy-change, and 4697 service-installation fixtures are synthetic-equivalent and Microsoft Learn-grounded; no live Windows relay capture or read-back.

Security Event 4726 account-deletion, 4732 local-group membership, 1102 audit-log-cleared, and 4698 scheduled-task fixtures are synthetic-equivalent and Microsoft Learn-grounded; no live Windows relay capture or read-back.
Security Event 4776 NTLM credential-validation fixture is synthetic-equivalent and Microsoft Learn-grounded; no live domain-controller relay capture or read-back.
Security Events 4768/4769/4771 Kerberos fixtures are synthetic-equivalent and Microsoft Learn-grounded; no live domain-controller relay capture or read-back.

pack_variants.label: Collector-normalized Windows Event JSON
pack_variants.description: Future variant placeholder for Winlogbeat/NXLog/Cribl JSON where the underlying Windows event is preserved but field names differ.
known_limitations: No JSON fixtures or parser route are shipped in this pack version.

cribl.notes: Use only after sampling the actual Windows relay schema. Do not drop command line, script block, security principal, or Defender detail fields by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

validation_commands: Start Data Prepper with the generated pipelines.yaml in a disposable test container and confirm pipeline startup before replay/read-back.
data_prepper.notes: Data Prepper support is recorded as a conservative OpenSearch ingestion pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Data Prepper pipeline artifact is generated by this pack yet.

opensearch_dashboards.config_model: index pattern/data view -> saved objects NDJSON -> dashboard/visualizations
validation_commands: Import exported NDJSON into a disposable OpenSearch Dashboards space and confirm data view/index-pattern resolution.
opensearch_dashboards.notes: OpenSearch Dashboards support is recorded as visualization-target metadata only. Splunk dashboards, where present, have not been automatically translated to OpenSearch saved objects or live-tested.

known_limitations: No live Windows relay, SC4S runtime replay, HEC delivery, Splunk read-back, Manager apply, or production evidence captured.
Synthetic-equivalent XML fixtures are documentation-shaped and do not prove source validation.
Initial parser routes selected EventID families only; Windows provider coverage is intentionally incomplete.
Collector JSON and native EVTX/multiline export modes are future variants, not implemented routes in this version.

logging_presets.label: Enhanced reviewed Windows reduction candidates

logging_presets.notes: Use only after local sampling and approval.
